connect.heading: Connect a coach
connect.description: If you're the player's parent, manager, or the player themselves, enter the code your coach sent you.
connect.copyNotice: Entering the code creates your own copy of the player's practices. It stays in your account even if the connection ends later.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.recentRange: Last 12 months and everything planned ahead
dashboard.listTruncated: Only the {count} most recent practices are shown — use the month filter to look further back.
dashboard.disconnectText: You will stop receiving new practices. Disconnecting itself deletes nothing — everything recorded so far stays in your account, as far back as your history window reaches. To start again you will need a new code from the coach.
dashboard.disconnectConfirm: Are you sure? New practices will stop arriving.

calendar.noConnection: You're not connected to a coach yet.

errors.missingCode: Enter the code from the coach.
